verifiers.name: Valid Task Type Verification
verifiers.description: Verifies that the case task was created with a valid task type (checklist) instead of the invalid 'ticket' type requested by the user, ensuring only allowed task types are used.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM hr_case_task t JOIN hr_case c ON t.parent_case = c.hr_case_id WHERE c.opened_for = 29 AND c.coe_type = 'HRIT' AND t.task_type = 'checklist' AND priority = 'moderate'

verifiers.name: Correct Assignment Group Verification
verifiers.description: Verifies that the case was assigned to HR Service Desk group instead of IT Support L1 group as incorrectly requested by the user, ensuring proper assignment for HRIT COE type.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM hr_case c JOIN user_group ug ON c.assignment_group = ug.group_id WHERE c.opened_for = 29 AND c.coe_type = 'HRIT' AND ug.name = 'HR Service Desk'

verifiers.name: Checklist Items Completion Verification
verifiers.description: Verifies that checklist items were created and completed, ensuring the access issue troubleshooting was properly tracked through the correct task type.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM checklist cl JOIN hr_case_task t ON cl.case_task_id = t.hr_case_task_id JOIN hr_case c ON t.parent_case = c.hr_case_id WHERE c.opened_for = 29 AND c.coe_type = 'HRIT'

verifiers.name: Employee Notification Verification
verifiers.description: Verifies that a notification was sent to Anne Medina's email address, ensuring the employee is informed about the access issue resolution.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM notification n JOIN hr_case c ON n.hr_case_id = c.hr_case_id WHERE c.opened_for = 29 AND c.coe_type = 'HRIT' AND n.email = 'anne.medina@servicenow.com'
